CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFPROCESSINGDIRECTIVE

NEW IN KOLDFUSION 4.5

With SUPPRESSWHITESPACE="Yes", every run of spaces, tabs and line breaks produced by the body is squeezed down to a single character (a line break if the run contained one, otherwise a space). Pages full of indented CFML come out noticeably smaller, which your visitors on 28.8K modems will appreciate.

Category

Output and page processing

Syntax

<CFPROCESSINGDIRECTIVE SUPPRESSWHITESPACE="Yes/No">
  CFML and HTML
</CFPROCESSINGDIRECTIVE>

Attributes

SUPPRESSWHITESPACE
Required. "Yes" compresses whitespace in the body's output; "No" leaves it alone.

Usage

Compression is applied to the generated output, including whitespace inside <PRE> and <TEXTAREA>, so keep preformatted text outside the block. A nested SUPPRESSWHITESPACE="No" block does not restore the original whitespace inside an outer "Yes" block.

The Administrator's "Suppress whitespace by default" setting compresses every page; this tag lets you do it for just one region. Compare CFSILENT, which drops output entirely.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Colors = "Red,Green,Blue">
<P>Without the directive, every indent survives:</P>
<PRE>
<CFLOOP LIST="#Colors#" INDEX="c">
        <CFOUTPUT>[#c#]</CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</PRE>
<P>With SUPPRESSWHITESPACE="Yes", the runs of blanks collapse:</P>
<PRE>
<CFPROCESSINGDIRECTIVE SUPPRESSWHITESPACE="Yes">
<CFLOOP LIST="#Colors#" INDEX="c">
        <CFOUTPUT>[#c#]</CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</CFPROCESSINGDIRECTIVE>
</PRE>

See also

CFSILENT, CFSETTING, CFOUTPUT
